response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: An account with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions has a NULL sum because no transaction contributes to that sum.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat an account with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions as having a zero sum.
alternatives.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
